svg.title: How the recommendation works. Two inputs, and they are the only two. Your measurements, only the ones you entered, blanks stay blank: bust, waist, hip. Plus the room you asked for: this garment's cut and your preferred fit, slim, regular or relaxed. Equals the body to look up, then the nearest size in this brand's published chart, then a confidence check that is allowed to decline. Deterministic and offline: no AI API, no model, no randomness and no network call. Partial profiles are first class: the weights (bust 0.45, waist 0.35, hip 0.2) renormalise over whatever you gave. Every answer carries a receipt built in the same function call. Nothing is estimated: an earlier height and weight estimator was deleted, because a guess presented as your body is worse than no answer.

section.h2: Two inputs, one chart, and the right to decline.
section.p: Deterministic and offline: no AI API, no model, no randomness and no network call anywhere in the feature.

div.p: Only the ones you entered. Blanks stay blank.
This garment's cut plus your preferred fit.
Matched to the nearest size in this brand's published chart, then a confidence check that may decline.

div.div: Partial profiles are first classWeights (bust 0.45, waist 0.35, hip 0.2) renormalise over what you gave. Skipped measurements are compared against nothing.
No size is also an answerBelow the threshold the UI names no size and hands over to the published chart.
Every answer has a receiptBuilt in the same function call as the size, so the explanation cannot drift from the computation.

div.span: An earlier build derived bust, waist and hip from height and weight. That is guessing, and a guess presented as your body is worse than no answer.
